THE ORACLE HAS SPOKEN

Week IX · The Blue Banner Rises

ProphecyPredictionsRankingsThe Saga
November 5, 2026 · An official transmission

The Blue Flag of Questionable Glory

From the slime-choked ruins of the Holy Realm, Shania Twain and Eimak raise a blue banner above a league held together by ancient grudges, injured hamstrings, and Roy’s increasingly offensive 7-1 record. The Oracle has seen six futures. In at least four of them, Jeff’s team is still called PeePee Magee.

These are Oracle predictions, not guarantees. Matchups and projected totals come from the league’s ESPN screenshots. Player analysis reflects the posted starters and publicly available Week 9 rankings as of Thursday; late injury and lineup changes can shift the picks.

Six contests · One unstable prophet

The Week 9 Predicks

Prophecy 01 / 06

Nation of Of Domination vs. Booger Eaters

Records: 4-4 / 3-5   ·   ESPN projected: 105.0 – 109.3

Drake Maye and Derrick Henry give Chris Polk a bruising foundation, and Justin Jefferson plus Tee Higgins can erase a deficit in a hurry. But Bijan Robinson, Javonte Williams and a strong receiving group give the Booger Eaters enough ways to score. Malik Willis is the wild card: if his passing output craters, this pick could rot on the temple floor.

✦ THE ORACLE CHOOSES: BOOGER EATERS

Jeff somehow managed to make his own team name sound like a urinary tract infection.

Prophecy 02 / 06

Serving Kuentz vs. Ukraine

Records: 7-1 / 3-5   ·   ESPN projected: 127.6 – 116.0

Roy has Josh Allen, Jahmyr Gibbs and Chris Olave. That is an actual lineup, much to the disgust of anyone who has ever watched him draft. Mike counters with Trevor Lawrence, Chase Brown, CeeDee Lamb and Tucker Kraft, but the projection gap and Roy’s elite anchors make the favorite hard to fade.

✦ THE ORACLE CHOOSES: SERVING KUENTZ

The Oracle predicts Roy wins the week and immediately behaves like he has won the Super Bowl. He still has zero league titles.

Prophecy 03 / 06

Show Me The Turtles vs. Demon Worship

Records: 6-2 / 6-2   ·   ESPN projected: 113.6 – 116.7

Sawyer can attack with Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Malik Nabers and Brock Bowers, three enormous weekly ceilings. Jacob has Saquon Barkley, James Cook, Zay Flowers and George Kittle, plus Brock Purdy in a favorable matchup. This is close, but the Oracle trusts Sawyer’s pass-catchers to break the projection tie.

✦ THE ORACLE CHOOSES: SHOW ME THE TURTLES

Jeff has been formally barred from this sacred showdown for bringing the smell of PeePee Magee into the amphitheater.

Prophecy 04 / 06

We B. Tuten vs. Poo Poo Magoo

Records: 3-5 / 3-5   ·   ESPN projected: 114.1 – 103.8

Maggie has Amon-Ra St. Brown, George Pickens and a potentially huge Omarion Hampton week, while Lucy needs Puka Nacua to carry an enormous share of the offense. Bhayshul Tuten’s Thursday status matters: verify whether he is active before kickoff. Even with that uncertainty, Maggie’s projected edge is persuasive.

✦ THE ORACLE CHOOSES: WE B. TUTEN

Lucy has named her team Poo Poo Magoo, somehow leaving Jeff with only the second-worst bathroom-themed identity in the league.

Prophecy 05 / 06

Carl MARXDONALD’S vs. Baba Yaga

Records: 3-5 / 5-3   ·   ESPN projected: 108.7 – 110.1

Nathan’s Jonathan Taylor and Jordan Love are dangerous, and Ashton Jeanty gives him another path to a big day. But Chris Arnold brings Joe Burrow, Ja’Marr Chase and Breece Hall. The Bengals stack could swing the entire contest on a few deep completions. Hall’s workload is worth monitoring, yet the Oracle calls the narrow upset.

✦ THE ORACLE CHOOSES: CARL MARXDONALD’S

The revolution does not require a majority vote. It requires one Burrow-to-Chase touchdown and Nathan looking uncomfortable.

Prophecy 06 / 06

PeePee Magee vs. Shaving Ryans privates

Records: 3-5 / 2-6   ·   ESPN projected: 116.9 – 112.8

Jeff rolls out Jared Goff, Kenneth Walker, Josh Jacobs and Nico Collins, a perfectly respectable set of players unfortunately employed by PeePee Magee. Hayden counters with Dak Prescott, Christian McCaffrey, Courtland Sutton and Trey McBride. McCaffrey’s health deserves a final check, but the Oracle likes Hayden’s ceiling in the upset.

✦ THE ORACLE CHOOSES: SHAVING RYANS PRIVATES

Jeff has spent eight weeks building a roster that looks decent on paper and still sits at 3-5. His team is the fantasy equivalent of a wet sock in a gas station urinal.

The continuing chronicle

Chapter IX: The Banner and the Blob

As the sun drowned in a sea of glowing mucus, Eimak emerged from the temple steps with Shania Twain at his side. Together they unfurled a blue banner so magnificent that even the ghosts of defeated fantasy managers stopped complaining about waiver priority.

Across the realm, Roy sat upon a throne built from seven victories and absolutely no championship trophies. He called this a dynasty. The peasants called it November.

Meanwhile, Jacob’s Demon Worshipers gathered around the Michael Landry Goop Entity, whose body now shifted between a cursed gelatinous prophet and the shape of an ESPN projection bar. Sawyer’s Turtles marched to meet them. Their collision would determine which faction controlled the eastern slime marshes.

Far beneath the ruins, Nathan heard the footsteps of revolution. Chris Arnold’s red banners advanced, bearing the sacred golden arches of Carl MARXDONALD’S. Somewhere in the distance, Joe Burrow sharpened his throwing arm.

Then came Jeff. Nobody had summoned him. Nobody wanted him. Yet he arrived carrying a damp parchment inscribed with the words PeePee Magee. The Oracle stared at him for a long moment and commanded the guards to escort him out of the story.

But Shania smiled. The blue flag rose higher. And Eimak whispered the only truth the realm could still believe: the playoffs will make fools of us all.
